role: AK_TEXT (lines and table rows); MODERN_EDITORIAL (the editor's numbers, brackets, note marks and folio references; his footnotes not reproduced)
comment: Frame 039, printed p. 33: the heading of the seventh clime, «الإقليم السابع عرضه مح», its latitude 48°, and of its cities; entries 475-487: مارٮاٮوس, a name that the editor supplies but for its last letter, at the mountain, Arāṭī, Mānāyālūs, Frāṭā, Abīrdabīn, Warqīs, an entry that is the word «مدينة» alone, Arzamī, Aslīthā, Chalcedon on a gulf, Heraclea and Aṭūrmā. Three lines of the editor's footnotes.

variants: L03: at entry (2071) the name is written مارٮانوس, with the dot of the ن.
L04: the manuscript has a gap; the editor supplies the name from entries (879-880); at entry (2147) the name is written نياقيلون.
L08: at entry (2148) the name is written انردس.
L09: at entry (2148) the name is written ورقس.
L13: at entry (1055) the name is written حلقيدون.
L15: at entry (1952) the name is written اطوما, with the variant reading الوما.
observations: L01-L02: the page begins with the heading of the seventh clime and of its cities, set between small open stars, followed by its first cities, entries 475-487. The latitude of the clime, «مح», 48°, is printed with a line above the numeral, transcribed with {ov:…}; the ح has no dot in the bowl. In both headings the alif of الإقليم carries a hamza below; L02: «الّتى», with a shadda over the ل, and «فى» without dots on the ى.

All entries have numbers of Suhrāb: [٤٣٧], [٤٤١], [٤٣٨], [٤٤٢], [٤٣٩], [٤٤٣], [٤٤٠] (entries 475-481) and [٤٤٤]-[٤٤٩] (entries 482-487). Entries 478 and 479 begin with the word «مدينة»; entry 482 is the word alone.

L04: the name of entry 476 is printed «⟨ماڡلو⟩ٮ»: the editor supplies the first five letters between angle brackets (note b: from entries 879-880); after the closing bracket stands an isolated ب without its dot, followed by the note mark b. The loop of the ف or ق has no dots.
L03: «مارٮاٮوس»: neither the tooth before the first alif nor the tooth before the و has a dot; the form that the editor's note a gives from entry (2071) has the dot of the ن. Transcribed as printed.

L13: «حلڡدوں»: an initial ح without a dot; a ل; a loop without dots standing above the line, 17 px high, as the ق of «هرقله» (L14); a د, a و and a final ن without its dot. Transcribed as printed; the note mark e stands above the left end of the ن.
L09: «ورقيس»: the و and the ر touch below the line; the ق has its two dots and the ي its two dots below.
Signs in the names, transcribed as printed: L05: «اراطى» and L11: «ارزمى» end in a ى without dots.

Letters printed without their dots in the numerals, transcribed so: ٮط (L03, the degrees of the longitude), the tooth without its dot; لٮ (L04, L05) and مٮ (L09), the degrees of the longitude, with a final ب without its dot, 32 and 42. With their dots: ن (L03, L11, the minutes of the longitude; L13, the degrees of the longitude); نج (L14), the ن with its dot above and the ج with its dot in the bowl; ند (L15); يه (L06); مز (L05, L09, the degrees of the latitude).

L04: the degrees of the latitude, «مر»: a ر without the dot of a ز; in these numerals the editor reads ر as ز, 7 (introduction, frame 196, p. XVII); transcribed ر as printed. L05 and L09 print the same degrees with the dot, مز.

The degrees printed with a final ح, مح (L07, L08, L12, the degrees of the latitude; L10, the degrees of the longitude), show no dot in the bowl; the same form is a ج without its dot, 3, which the print gives with its dot in نج (L14). Transcribed as printed.

The isolated ك, 20, is printed with the small inner stroke of the letter (L04, L10, L15, the minutes of the longitude; L08, L11, the minutes of the latitude). The minutes of the latitude in L07 and L09, «ٮه», are a tooth without its dot joined to a final ه, the form that L06 prints with the two dots of the ي, يه.

Specks, not transcribed: L09, a dark speck, 4 by 5 px, above the left part of the degrees of the longitude, «مٮ», where a ب has its dot below; L04 and L12, dark specks to the right of the column of the longitude.
Below the notes, at the left, the signature «3» of the printed sheet; the page number «— ٣٣ —» stands at the foot, centred.
copy_matter: Faint wavy grey hairlines, fibres on the paper: L02, to the right of the heading; L08, to the left of the name.
